name: Exp_MFI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the MFI (Money Flow Index) Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when MFI crosses above the lower level from the overbought zone and sell positions when MFI crosses below the upper level from the oversold zone. It uses a custom MFI_Histogram indicator with color-coded buffers to determine market direction and executes trades with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MFI（资金流量指数）直方图自定义指标进行交易，当MFI从超卖区域上穿低水平位时开多仓，当MFI从超买区域下穿高水平位时开空仓。它使用带颜色编码缓冲区的MFI_Histogram指标判断市场方向，并配合可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈执行交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是利用MFI直方图指标的颜色变化来判断动量转换。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1（颜色值）从2（超买区，蓝色）变为0且缓冲区0值大于0时，视为上升趋势信号，开多仓；当缓冲区1从0变为2且缓冲区0值小于2时，视为下降趋势信号，开空仓。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及止损止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按净可用保证金比例、按净余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，默认使用固定手数模式（LOT）。策略在H4周期上运行，属于中期动量跟踪类型，信号基于前一根K线的指标值（SignalBar=1），避免未来数据重绘。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses MFI Histogram indicator color changes to detect momentum shifts. Entry conditions: when buffer 1 (color value) transitions from 2 (overbought zone, blue) to 0 and buffer 0 value is greater than 0, it signals an uptrend and opens a buy position; when buffer 1 transitions from 0 to 2 and buffer 0 value is less than 2, it signals a downtrend and opens a sell position. Exit conditions include reverse signal triggers for closing positions, plus stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of net free margin, percentage of net balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT). The strategy operates on the H4 timeframe, representing a medium-term momentum-following approach, with signals based on the previous bar's indicator values (SignalBar=1) to avoid repainting issues.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Margin usage ratio for lot size calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：按可用保证金/余额/净保证金/净余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode (free margin/balance/net loss/fixed lots)

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：跳价量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

pros: 使用MFI动量指标，逻辑清晰，信号基于区域穿越而非单一阈值，减少虚假信号
支持五种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
信号基于已完成K线（SignalBar=1），避免重绘问题，回测结果可靠
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活配置为只做多或只做空
pros_en: Uses MFI momentum indicator with clear logic; signals are based on zone crossover rather than a single threshold, reducing false signals
Supports five position sizing modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences and account sizes
Signals are based on completed bars (SignalBar=1), avoiding repainting issues and ensuring reliable backtesting results
Buy and sell switches are independently controlled, allowing flexible configuration such as long-only or short-only modes
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，可能在极端行情下造成严重亏损
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能出现入场价格不佳的情况
依赖自定义指标MFI_Histogram，指标文件缺失时EA将无法运行
没有仓位检查和最大持仓限制，可能在连续信号下过度开仓
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are very large, which may cause significant losses in extreme market conditions
Lacks spread filtering, which may result in unfavorable entry prices in high-spread environments
Depends on a custom MFI_Histogram indicator; the EA will fail to run if the indicator file is missing
No position check or maximum position limit, potentially leading to over-opening on consecutive signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量限制，提升风险控制能力
加入移动止损（Trailing Stop）功能，保护浮盈并优化出场逻辑
improvements_en: Add spread filtering and maximum position count limits to improve risk control
Implement a trailing stop feature to protect floating profits and optimize exit logic

risk_points: 止损点数极大（1000点），单笔交易可能承受较大亏损
缺少持仓数量检查，连续信号可能导致多次开仓叠加风险
依赖外部自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA仅打印警告但未终止初始化
risk_points_en: Very large stop loss (1000 points), single trades may incur significant losses
No position count check, consecutive signals may lead to multiple stacked positions increasing risk
Depends on external custom indicator; when indicator fails to load, EA only prints a warning but does not abort initialization
